definition: the outline of a city against the sky
description: A young woman in a green satin robe stands at a floor-to-ceiling hotel window with the outline of a whole city of tower blocks stretching away behind her under a pale sky. Holding an open bronze powder compact in one hand, she sweeps a make-up brush high on her cheekbone, then along the bridge of her nose and her brow, and finally under her chin, checking herself between strokes with wide eyes and an open mouth. At the end she lowers the brush, smiles at the camera and holds the compact up beside her face.

taps.phrase: to apply powder with a brush
to raise her eyebrows in surprise
